# Rex

> Rex is a zero-dependency Go library for building regular expressions from
> human-friendly, composable tokens. It compiles to a standard Go
> `*regexp.Regexp`, supports groups, character classes, repetitions, and raw
> regex fragments, and ships predefined helpers for numbers ranges, phones,
> emails, hostnames, IPs, and hashes.

Key facts:

- Module: `github.com/hedhyw/rex` (Go, MIT license, stable since v1.0.0).
- Main import path: `github.com/hedhyw/rex/pkg/rex`.
- Entry point: `rex.New(tokens...)` with namespaces `rex.Chars`,
  `rex.Common`, `rex.Group`, `rex.Helper`; finish with `.MustCompile()`,
  `.Compile()`, or `.String()`.
- Token interfaces live in `github.com/hedhyw/rex/pkg/dialect`; the base
  dialect implementation in `github.com/hedhyw/rex/pkg/dialect/base`.
- `cmd/generator` is an unfinished experimental CLI for converting a
  regular expression into rex builder code.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/hedhyw/rex/blob/main/README.md): overview,
  motivation, examples, FAQ.
- [Library documentation](https://github.com/hedhyw/rex/blob/main/_docs/library.md):
  full API reference with produced regex for each token.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/hedhyw/rex/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guide for
  AI coding agents — layout, build/test/lint commands, conventions.
- [pkg.go.dev](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/hedhyw/rex): generated Go API
  documentation.
